en: The image shows a historical black-and-white photograph of a waterfront scene. There are several sailboats docked at a small pier, with a building and a flagpole visible. Several people are standing on the pier. The background features hills and sparse vegetation. The style and quality of the image suggest it is from the early 20th century. Printed text at the bottom reads 'Klippans tullstation, Göteborg.'
